author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Balina Bread Recipe | Turkish-Style Village Bread
Ingredients:
300 g bread flour
100 g whole wheat flour
40 g rye flour
40 g spelt or einkorn flour
20 g fine corn flour or oat flour
315–330 g lukewarm water
5 g instant yeast or 15 g fresh yeast
9 g salt
1 tsp honey or sugar, optional

1. Mix all the flours, yeast, and 315 g of water until combined. Let the dough rest for 20 minutes.
2. Add salt and honey or sugar if using. Knead for 8–10 minutes by hand or 6–7 minutes in a mixer, until smooth and elastic.
3. Cover and let the dough rise for 60–75 minutes, or until doubled in size.
4. Shape into a large oval loaf. Cover and let it proof for 35–50 minutes.
5. Preheat the oven to 230°C / 445°F. Place a metal tray at the bottom of the oven for steam.
6. Score the top of the bread. Add hot water to the tray and bake for 15 minutes with steam.
7. Reduce the temperature to 200°C / 390°F and bake for another 25–35 minutes, until golden brown.
